subject.title: Feature: Processing indicator message for Telegram (send ⌛️ while thinking, delete on reply)

question: Should OpenClaw support a standalone Telegram processing-placeholder message, fold this into broader acknowledgement text, or rely on typing/status reactions instead?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds Telegram-visible behavior and config surface that overlaps an open presence PR and a broader acknowledgement-text issue.

options.title: Sponsor Narrow Telegram Placeholder
options.body: Add a default-off Telegram plugin config that sends, tracks, deletes, and edits a standalone placeholder message after an eligible inbound message is accepted.

options.title: Fold Into Acknowledgement Text
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/8285 as the canonical product direction and keep this issue as Telegram-specific lifecycle context.

options.title: Rely On Presence Cues
options.body: Decline standalone placeholder messages and make Telegram responsiveness depend on typing, ack/status reactions, or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80690 after its blockers are resolved.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Narrow Telegram Placeholder
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Telegram plugin config that sends, tracks, deletes, and edits a standalone placeholder message after an eligible inbound message is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from recent Telegram history and prior issue review of the lifecycle/config decision.
